english.title: Use on a road a goods vehicle which was not fitted with a speed limiter
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with a speed limiter
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 36B(6) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
